verificationLimits: Closed-page axe checks only; no open-dialog, Firefox ESR140 or native accessibility acceptance.
Every switch position is authored debug state; no preference is stored, no prefix is stripped, no session is restored and no analysis runs.

Rectangles and line counts are device layout reports, not glyph metrics; switch positions, header contrast, the empty page after the rows and the retained left half are re-measured from the embedded pixels.
The Fold placement follows D50, D51 and the existing Settings behaviour; it was adopted, not separately chosen.
Synthetic changed-inset and changed-witness fixtures are validation controls, not extra Android captures.
Full Android lint retains five inherited errors; no finding names a Settings study file.
